name.zh: 跟婦女長輩處理苧麻：剝皮、浸泡、曬乾
name.en: Prepare ramie with the women elders: strip, soak and dry

steps.text: 族女向女性長輩接下工作：去簷廊幫忙處理苧麻
steps.textEn: The Tao woman takes a job from the woman elder: help prepare ramie on the porch

lines.zh: 苧麻收回來了，要剝皮、浸泡、曬乾。族女去簷廊幫婦女長輩，這要忙一陣子。
lines.en: The ramie is in. It needs stripping, soaking and drying. The Tao woman will help the women elders on the porch — this takes a while.

lines.zh: 其他人先去忙別的，等一下帶水過去幫她。
lines.en: The rest of you go do something else, then bring her some water.

steps.text: 族男或旅人先到椰油的雜貨店買飲水，帶去簷廊
steps.textEn: The Tao man or the traveller buys water at the Yayo grocery store and takes it to the porch

lines.zh: 要帶水去給在簷廊忙的人？拿去吧。
lines.en: Water for the people working on the porch? Here you go.

steps.text: 帶水到簷廊，幫忙把苧麻收好，接族女回隊
steps.textEn: Bring the water to the porch, help put the ramie away, and bring the Tao woman back to the party

lines.zh: 來，苧麻的皮這樣剝下來，泡在水裡，再拿去曬乾。
lines.en: Here — strip the ramie bark like this, soak it, then dry it.

lines.zh: 有你們幫忙快多了！原來要這麼多步驟，才會變成可以織的線。
lines.en: So much faster with your help! It takes this many steps to become thread you can weave.

lines.zh: 依文獻記載，飛魚汛期婦女不織布，所以這件事在非飛魚季才做；各部落細節還要請族人確認。
lines.en: According to written records, women don't weave during the flying fish run, so this is done outside flying fish season. Details for each village still need checking with the community.

toast: 已寫進手札。族女回到隊上了。
toastEn: Added to your notebook. The Tao woman is back with the party.

steps.text: 族女向女性長輩回報：苧麻處理好了
steps.textEn: The Tao woman reports to the woman elder: the ramie is done

lines.zh: 苧麻都處理好了？做得很好，大家一起幫忙就快了。
lines.en: All the ramie is done? Well done. It goes fast when everyone helps.

hint.zh: 女性長輩在找族女幫忙處理苧麻；族女會留在簷廊，其他人要帶水去幫她。
hint.en: The woman elder is looking for the Tao woman to help prepare ramie. The Tao woman will stay on the porch; the others should bring her water.

name.zh: 看婦女長輩在簷廊織一小段布
name.en: Watch a woman elder weave a short piece of cloth on the porch

text.unlock: 織布學習卡（只畫簡單的背帶織布機，不畫織紋與禮衣）
text.unlockEn: Weaving card (only a simple backstrap loom, no woven patterns or ceremonial clothes)

steps.text: 族女在簷廊看婦女長輩織一小段布
steps.textEn: The Tao woman watches a woman elder weave a short piece of cloth on the porch

lines.zh: 這是背帶織布機，腰靠著這條帶子，線就拉緊了。你先看就好。
lines.en: This is a backstrap loom. Lean your waist against this strap and the threads pull tight. Just watch for now.

lines.zh: 織布有一些禁忌，例如喪忌期間不碰織布機、男子不跨過織布機。這裡只用旁白說明，遊戲不會讓你去做。
lines.en: Weaving has some taboos — for example, no touching the loom during mourning, and men don't step over the loom. This is only explained here; the game won't make you do it.

lines.zh: 織紋與禮衣不在這裡呈現，等族人校對後再決定。
lines.en: Woven patterns and ceremonial clothes aren't shown here. That waits until the community has reviewed it.

hint.zh: 苧麻曬好了，族女可以來簷廊看看織布。
hint.en: The ramie is dry. The Tao woman can come to the porch to watch the weaving.

name.en: Feed the pigs and chickens near the house

text.unlockEn: Livestock field guide (kois pig), food store

steps.text: 向女性長輩接下工作：在家屋附近餵豬、餵雞
steps.textEn: Take a job from the woman elder: feed the pigs and chickens near the house

lines.zh: 家屋附近的豬和雞該餵了，交給你。做好了回來跟我說。
lines.en: The pigs and chickens by the house need feeding. Can you do it? Come back and tell me when you're done.

steps.text: 族女在主人家附近餵豬、餵雞
steps.textEn: The Tao woman feeds the pigs and chickens near the host family's house

lines.zh: 豬和雞都餓了，先餵牠們。
lines.en: The pigs and chickens are hungry. Feed them first.

lines.zh: 餵完再去看看糧倉。
lines.en: After feeding, go check the food store.

steps.text: 向女性長輩回報：在家屋附近餵豬、餵雞
steps.textEn: Report to the woman elder: fed the pigs and chickens near the house

lines.zh: 餵過了？我看過了，做得很好。
lines.en: All fed? I checked. Well done.

hint.zh: 家屋旁邊的豬和雞要有人餵，族女會去。
hint.en: The pigs and chickens by the house need feeding. The Tao woman will go.

name.zh: 隱藏：茅草地的午後（幫主人家割茅草）
name.en: Hidden: an afternoon in the thatch field (cut thatch for the host family)

text.seasonEn: Summer and autumn after flying fish season
text.pre: 第一次走進茅草地遇到婦女長輩
text.preEn: First time in the thatch field meeting a woman elder
text.unlock: 茅草圖鑑、主人家的一句讚美
text.unlockEn: Thatch field guide, a word of praise from the host family

steps.text: 女性長輩約族女下午去割茅草
steps.textEn: The woman elder asks the Tao woman to cut thatch in the afternoon

lines.zh: 涼亭的屋頂要補了。下午跟我去山坡上割茅草。
lines.en: The pavilion roof needs patching. Come cut thatch on the hillside with me this afternoon.

steps.text: 族女跟女性長輩在茅草地割茅草，一把一把綁好
steps.textEn: The Tao woman and the woman elder cut thatch and tie it in bundles

lines.zh: 手套戴好，葉子邊很利。
lines.en: Put your gloves on. The leaf edges are sharp.

lines.zh: 割下來的，綁成一樣大的一把，背回去才好算。
lines.en: Tie what you cut into bundles of the same size. Easier to count when we carry them back.

steps.text: 回家後，長輩看著族女綁的茅草
steps.textEn: Back home, the elder looks at the thatch the Tao woman tied

lines.zh: 綁得很整齊，跟妳外婆以前一樣。
lines.en: Very neat. Just like your Grandma used to do.

toast: 主人家的長輩稱讚了族女。
toastEn: The host family's elder praised the Tao woman.

hint.zh: 冬天的下午，主人家的女性長輩好像要上山坡做什麼。
hint.en: On a winter afternoon, the host family's woman elder seems to be heading up the hillside for something.

review: 割茅草由誰做（男性或女性）、茅草用在哪裡，請族人確認

name.zh: 把小一點的飛魚放在外圍，留給行動不便的長輩
name.en: Put the smaller flying fish around the edge for elders who can't get around

steps.text: 族男在灘頭問船組，小一點的飛魚怎麼處理
steps.textEn: On the beach, the Tao man asks the crew what to do with the smaller flying fish

lines.zh: 小的放外圍，留給走不動、不能出海的長輩。他們會自己來拿，或請孩子來。
lines.en: The small ones go around the edge, for elders who can't walk far or go to sea. They come and take them, or send a child.

steps.text: 族男把小一點的飛魚放在外圍
steps.textEn: The Tao man puts the smaller flying fish around the edge

lines.zh: 這幾條放這裡。長輩來的時候，一眼就看得到。
lines.en: These go here. When the elders come, they'll see them right away.

steps.text: 向男性長輩回報
steps.textEn: Report to the man elder

lines.zh: 能出海的人，要想到不能出海的人。這就是分享。
lines.en: Those who can go to sea should think of those who can't. That's sharing.

toast: 小一點的飛魚留給了行動不便的長輩。
toastEn: The smaller flying fish were kept for the elders who can't get around.

hint.zh: 分魚的時候，船組會把小一點的飛魚放在外圍，留給長輩。
hint.en: When sharing fish, the crew puts the smaller flying fish around the edge for the elders.

review: 把較小的飛魚留給行動不便長輩的分享做法請族人確認

name.zh: 飛魚季後修整田埂與灌溉水道
name.en: Repair field banks and water channels after flying fish season

text.unlockEn: Nature points, taro field care card

steps.text: 向女性長輩接下工作：飛魚季後修整田埂與灌溉水道
steps.textEn: Take a job from the woman elder: repair field banks and water channels after flying fish season

lines.zh: 飛魚季過了，田埂和水道該修一修。交給你了，做好了回來跟我說。
lines.en: Flying fish season is over. The field banks and channels need fixing. It's up to you — come tell me when you're done.

steps.text: 飛魚季後，族男修整田埂與灌溉水道
steps.textEn: After flying fish season, the Tao man repairs the field banks and water channels

lines.zh: 田埂被水沖壞了一點，補一補，水道也清一清。
lines.en: The water damaged the bank a little. Patch it up and clear the channel too.

lines.zh: 修田埂的月份還要請族人確認。
lines.en: Which month the banks are repaired still needs checking with the community.

steps.text: 向女性長輩回報：飛魚季後修整田埂與灌溉水道
steps.textEn: Report to the woman elder: repaired the field banks and water channels

lines.zh: 田埂和水道修好了？我看過了，做得很好。
lines.en: Banks and channels fixed? I checked. Well done.

hint.zh: 非飛魚季的時候，田埂和水道要整理。
hint.en: Outside flying fish season, the field banks and channels need tidying.

text.pre: 第一次在山邊看到羊群
text.preEn: First time seeing a goat herd by the hills
text.unlock: 羊的圖鑑、族語詞卡加 kagling
text.unlockEn: Goat field guide, kagling added to Tao word cards

steps.text: 紅頭的長輩說：一隻羊沒回來
steps.textEn: The Imorod elder says: a goat didn't come home

lines.zh: 耳朵缺一角的那隻羊，昨天沒回來。山上找過了，你再去找找。
lines.en: The goat with a notch in its ear didn't come back yesterday. I looked on the mountain. Go look again.

lines.zh: 看到別人家的羊，不要碰。只找我們家的記號。
lines.en: If you see other families' goats, don't touch them. Only look for our family's mark.

steps.text: 族男先上紅頭山找
steps.textEn: The Tao man searches Mt. Hongtou first

lines.zh: 這裡的羊耳朵都是完整的……不是我們家的。
lines.en: These goats' ears are all whole… not ours.

steps.text: 族男沿著路找到虎頭坡
steps.textEn: The Tao man follows the road to Hutou Slope

lines.zh: 找到了！耳朵缺一角，就是牠。跑得真遠。
lines.en: Found it! Notched ear — that's the one. It ran so far.

lines.zh: 走吧，kagling，回家了。
lines.en: Come on, kagling, let's go home.

steps.text: 把羊帶回紅頭
steps.textEn: Bring the goat back to Imorod

lines.zh: 回來就好。羊認得路，人也要認得路。
lines.en: Good, it's back. Goats know the way, and people should too.

toastEn: kagling (goat) added to Tao word cards.

hint.zh: 紅頭的長輩好像在數羊，數來數去少了一隻。
hint.en: The Imorod elder seems to be counting goats — and keeps coming up one short.

review: kagling（羊）為既有內容中的詞，詞卡寫法請族人確認
羊耳記號的說法請族人確認

note: A1 moved to quests/split.json (now a playable leave-and-return quest).
